acceptance: Her workstream completed ve kanıt bağlantılıdır.
Locale, lint, typecheck, web build, API test ve Release build kapıları geçer.
Gerekli migrationlar önce staging sonra production üzerinde uygulanır.
Public ve admin kritik rotaları mobil/masaüstü ile açık/koyu temada doğrulanır.
Production sağlık, servis, worker, sitemap ve yedek bileşenleri sağlıklıdır.
Canlıya çıkan her özellik için rollback ve audit kanıtı vardır.
Umbrella yol haritası maddesi yalnız bütün koşullar sağlanınca completed olur.

evidence.summary: Exclusive five-minute leases, heartbeat renewal, bounded exponential retry and terminal dead-letter persistence are implemented; admin reports active, deferred and terminal counts. Staging and production migration evidence is still required before completion.

Normalized focal coordinates are persisted on media assets with database constraints, audited with candidate evidence, editable by pointer or keyboard in the admin crop matrix, and applied to public homepage and article hero rendering with a safe center fallback. Staging migration, light/dark browser captures and production promotion evidence are still required before completion.

Source centers, source archives and legal pages now publish self-canonical metadata, only real locale alternatives, visible locale-aware breadcrumbs and matching CollectionPage, ItemList, WebPage and BreadcrumbList data. Sitemap entries carry the same real-alternative contract. Staging and production HTTP/render evidence is still required before completion.

Published locale editions now accept editor-authorized, append-only correction records with bounded plain-text fields and audit evidence. Public articles expose only their own locale's records as a semantic correction timeline; admin provides a dedicated four-locale management surface. Staging backup/restore/migration, real light/dark render and production promotion remain required before completion.

Locale-specific editor-approved claim citations now bind only sources already attached to the article, persist approval evidence, emit audit events, and render as an accessible reader-facing evidence panel distinct from the general bibliography. Staging backup/restore/migration, light/dark browser captures and production promotion remain required before completion.

The admin freshness queue now combines content age, source review, measured on-site reader demand and SEO quality debt without inventing missing traffic. Editors can idempotently claim an audited high-priority revision task only from the published Turkish source edition. Autonomous delivery now blocks all production backup, migration and deployment until the complete changed staging cohort passes health checks. Live render and staging/production promotion evidence are still required before completion.

Consented anonymous field cohorts now show mobile and desktop evidence with locale-correct copy, while a deterministic fail-closed root JavaScript, client chunk and CSS artifact budget runs before any staging mutation. Staging migration, consent beacon, light/dark render, retention and production promotion evidence are still required before completion.
